text:
Sam R: starting the canary for v3.7.2 now, window is 02:00-03:00 PST. I pushed the release notes to /releases/v3.7.2, please review.
Marta O: reading notes, flagged the DB migration step — is it deferred to quiet window?
Sam R: yes, migration deferred. this deploy is config+model pin only. no schema changes.
deploybot: [deploy started] canary group: 10% traffic -> instances: inference-canary-2, inference-canary-3
Theo L: monitoring latency and error budget. will signal if 5xx rate >0.5% or p50 > 220ms for 2 consecutive mins.
Priya S: adding quick rollback play: ops runbook link -> https://wiki.internal/redwood/runbooks/revert-containers (see section 'pin-and-unpin').
Marta O: copy that. also adding an emergency revert checklist to thread: 1) hit `ops-bot revert v3.7.2 --scope=canary` 2) pin traffic to v3.7.1 3) notify customers via status page 4) open incident if errors persist.
Sam R: ops-bot, please confirm revert command syntax for me.
ops-bot: Confirmed. revert command: `ops-bot revert --tag v3.7.2 --mode canary --reason "canary regressions"` . See runbook: https://wiki.internal/redwood/runbooks/revert-containers#quick-evac
Theo L: canary saw a small spike at +4m, p95 up 110ms but p50 still fine. no 5xxs. holding.
Priya S: double-checking data-plane cache TTL change — that was rolled back in staging but not prod. we should not unpin until we validate cache behaviour.
Sam R: good catch. marking hold until cache check completes. if cache looks good by +20m we continue canary ramp to 50%.
Marta O: if we need to back out, follow the runbook's 'fast-unwind' steps: run revert, flush prefix cache `redis-cli -h cache -n 2 KEYS "model:v3*" | xargs -L 100 redis-cli -h cache DEL`, then confirm KV cache relationships.
Theo L: adding monitoring checklist to incident channel: traces, tail logs from inference-canary-2/3, and sampling for hallucination rate.
deploybot: [canary ramp] 25% traffic -> inference-canary-4 completed
Sam R: decision: hold at 25% until cache TTL validated. leaving a pinned tag on rollout to prevent auto-unpin. note in release notes: pinned-for-validation.
Priya S: ETA on TTL validation ~12m. will post results. if negative, we follow revert checklist above and escalate to incident.
Marta O: FYI I attached the runbook excerpt to the ticket: https://tickets.internal/RED-4321 and included both revert and rollback commands.
Sam R: thanks team. small, clear steps — if anything hits thresholds, call the revert and I’ll coordinate the postmortem and release note updates. :thumbsup:
